content_blocks.text: The forest was a sea of green, the trees towering over me like ancient sentinels. The air was cool and damp, carrying the scent of pine needles and earth. As I walked deeper into the woods, the path became narrower, leading me towards a clearing where a small fire burned brightly. Smoke curled upwards, creating a haze that made the world seem both familiar and distant. The fire was the last ember of something that had once been great, a symbol of resilience and hope in the face of darkness.
